chapter_name: A Journey Through States of Water
learning_objective: 🎯 To explore the magical ways water transforms into ice, liquid, and invisible vapour, and understand nature's amazing water cycle!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Water is a master of disguise! It can be a hard solid (like ice cubes), a flowing liquid (like the water you drink), or an invisible gas (like steam or vapour floating in the air).
When the hot sun shines on wet clothes or puddles, it heats the water. The water turns into invisible vapour and flies up into the sky! This clever vanishing trick is called evaporation.

When warm water vapour floats high up where it is cold, it turns back into tiny liquid water drops to form clouds. When the drops get too heavy, they fall back down as rain! This cooling change is condensation.

fun_activity.title: ☁️ Catching Water Vapour
fun_activity.instructions: Take a glass of completely dry outside and fill it with ice cubes and cold water. Wait a few minutes and watch the outside of the glass. You will see water drops appear from the invisible vapour in the air!

quick_recap: ⭐ Water exists in three different states: solid (ice), liquid (water), and gas (water vapour).
⭐ Heating changes liquid water into vapour, and cooling changes vapour back into liquid.
⭐ The continuous movement of water between the Earth and the sky is called the Water Cycle.
